paite: Alal kum kuana kum, akha sawmna, ani sawm ni in hichi ahong hi a, asepaih tengteng toh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong dou a, om mun ava bawl a; kulh in a-umsuakta hi.
heading: Jerusalem Pukna / (2 Kro 36.13-21; Jer 52.3b-11)
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

paite: Hichi in kumpipa Zedekiah lal akum sawm-le-khatna tan in khua um in a-om hi.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

paite: Akha lina, ani kua ni in khua akial mahmahta a, huai gam mite a ding in tanghou a-om kei hi.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

paite: Khopi kulh ahihvang ua, zan in gal dou thei mi tengteng kumpipa huan ning, kulhbaang nih kikal a kulh kongpi ah ataikhe vek ua; Kaldaite'n khua a umsuak uhi; kumpipa Arabah lampi ah apai hi.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah apha ua; asepaih tengteng in amah taizaksan vek uhi.
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah api ua; atungtang thu angaihtuah uhi.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

paite: Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat ua, Zedekiah mitte akhelkhiaksak ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar lal akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, ani sagih ni in Jerusalem ah Babulon kumpipa vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan alut hi.
heading: Tempul Hihsiatna / (Jer 52.12-33)
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a; Jerusalem inn tengteng, inn thupi taktakte ahal hi.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu kiang a om Kaldai sepaih tengteng in Jerusalem kim a kulhte ahihchim vek uhi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

paite: Khopi sung a nutsiat a om mite, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipia mite leh mipi dang teng vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in sal in api vek hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

paite: Huai gam a azawng tatate lak a mite vengmi pawl heutu in grepgui kem ding leh lou bawl ding in anusia hi.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh atunnate leh dal limlang tuipi Kaldaite'n ahihkekgawp vek ua, adal Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

paite: Belte, vutluahnate, khawnvak puantehnate, keute leh dal tui-um belsuan tengteng, nasepna dia azatte uh ala uhi.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

paite: Mei laknate, belkuangte toh, vengmi pawl heutu in dangka-eng abawlte bel adangka-eng ala a, dangkasik a bawlte adangka ala hi.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl khuampi nih, tuikuangpi khat leh atunnate leh hiai vanzat tengteng bawlna dal buk theih vual ahi kei hi.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

paite: Khuam khat sandan tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, adawn ah dal sunbawk a-om a; huai sunbawk sandan tong thum ahi. Sunbawk kim ah agial tiktek leh theibuhfai atuang a, dal a bawl vek ahi uh. Huchi mah bang in khuampi khat leng agial tiktek hi.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh azompa siampu Zephaniah leh kongkhak vengmi thum aman hi.
heading: Juda Mite Babulon A Pi Ahi Uh / (Jer 52.24-27)
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

paite: Galdou thei mite tung a heutu khat toh, kumpipa kiang a om khopi tung a om lai ngate toh, mipite mingelhpa sepaihte heutu laigelhmi toh, khopi sung a om lai gam a mi sawmguk toh khopi sung a pan aman hi.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in amau api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah apaipih hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam, Riblah ah amau ana that hi. Huchi in Judah, agamsung a pan sal a pikhiak in a-omta hi.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah gam a anutsiat teng tung ah Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah ukpa ding in abawl hi.
heading: Judah Ukpipa Gedaliah / (Jer 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

paite: Huchi in sepaih pawl heutu tengteng leh aheute'n Babulon kumpipa'n Gedaliah ukpa in abawl chih azak un Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahoh ua, huaite bel Nathaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Mak mi tapa Jaazaniah leh aheute ahi uhi.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

paite: Gedaliah huai mite leh aheute uh kiang ah akichiam a, akiang uah, "Kaldaite sikha a om lau kei un. Hiai gam ah teng unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem un, huchi in nou a ding in ahoih ding," achi hi.
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

paite: Himahleh akha sagihna ah hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa suan Elishama tapa, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi sawmkhat toh ahong kuan a, Mizpah a Juda mi leh Kaldai mi akiang a om teng leh Gedaliah ahong sual ua, athat vek uhi.
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng aneu leh alian in sepaih heutute toh apawtkhia ua, Kaldaite alauh ziak un Aigupta gam ah apaita uhi.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in alal pat tung kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin atanna inn a pan akhahkhia hi.
heading: Suangkul A Pan Jehoiakin Khahkhiak Ahi / (Jer 52.31-34)
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

paite: Akiang ah hoihtak in thu agen a, Babulon a kumpipa om samte laltutphah tung ah alaltutphah akoihsang tuamse hi.
english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

paite: Atanna inn puansilhte akheng a, adamsung teng in akiang ah an ane gige samta hi.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

paite: Huchi in aloh ding, kumpipa'n apiak tatlak lou a-om a, adamsung teng in, niteng a azat ding abawlsak gige hi.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
